nodes.name: Gap Analysis
nodes.summary: Comprehensive gap analysis comparing current implementation to target architecture (as of 2026-06-28). Backend is 100% complete (218 endpoints, 56 tables, 33 service classes). Frontend is functionally complete (48 pages, all CRUD) but only 40% of the design target (JenStore/Fleetio) is delivered. Phases 3-6 of the master plan are 0-15% complete. Identifies 14 technical debt items, 8 missing modules, and 4 tiers of prioritized remediation tasks. Overall platform score: 72%.

nodes.name: Implementation Backlog
nodes.summary: Ordered backlog of 59 discrete, shippable work items (P0–P3 priority) with effort estimates and sprint assignments. P0 blockers: CSS extraction, shared types, alert→toast. P1 critical: work order form, spare part form, settings page, permission-aware sidebar. Covers profitability engine (Phase 9), executive BI (Phase 10), test infrastructure, and CI/CD. Total estimated effort: ~81.5 days (16 weeks, 1 developer). Includes 8-sprint execution plan and acceptance criteria template.

nodes.name: Architecture Documentation Portal
nodes.summary: Self-contained dark-themed HTML documentation portal for DK CRM architecture diagrams. Features a fixed sidebar navigation, card-based diagram grid with SVG/PNG download buttons, and a fullscreen zoom modal. Serves as a visual index for all architecture diagrams (ER diagrams, system architecture, data flow, etc.) generated alongside the markdown docs.

nodes.name: Refactor Plan
nodes.summary: 10-phase refactor plan with file-level change specifications for the entire frontend and backend. Baseline: 218 endpoints, 56 tables, 48 pages, 0 tests, 491 inline styles, 5 cross-module CSS imports. Cross-cutting work (CSS extraction, shared types, alert→toast, permission-aware sidebar, settings page) precedes module phases. Phases 1-8 harden existing modules (catalog, equipment, quotation, rental, movement, maintenance, inventory, billing). Phases 9-10 add profitability analysis engine and executive BI. Total: 12 new files, 38 modified files, 8 weeks estimated.

nodes.name: Product Roadmap
nodes.summary: Version-by-version product roadmap for the DK Service Enterprise Platform (FastAPI + React 19 + TypeScript). Tracks v1.0–v1.9 by module: Product Catalog (95%), Equipment Registry (95%), Quotation (95%), Rental (95%), Movement (90%), Maintenance (85%), Spare Parts (85%), Billing (90%), Profitability (20%), Executive BI (40%). Overall: 218 endpoints, 56 models, 48+ pages, 79% complete. Identifies remaining gaps per version and cross-cutting concerns (tests, permissions, CI/CD, rate limiting). Provides recommended execution order.

nodes.name: Testing Strategy
nodes.summary: 4-layer testing architecture for the DK CRM platform. Current state: 0 tests, 0 frameworks installed, no CI/CD. Targets: 80 backend tests (pytest + httpx + factory-boy), 30 frontend tests (vitest + React Testing Library), 5 E2E journeys (Playwright). Coverage targets: 80% backend API, 70% backend services, 90% frontend stores. Includes conftest.py fixtures, test file structure, critical scenario examples (rental activation chain, RBAC parametrize), GitHub Actions CI/CD YAML, and a 4-week ramp-up timeline.
